source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.group: Death Company Captain with Jump Pack
data.summary:
In [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit finishes fighting, if its attacks **destroyed** this model, you can roll a D6, with +2 to the roll if an enemy **WARLORD** unit was in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of this model. That enemy unit then takes:

- 2-3: D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**
- 4-5: 3 mortal wounds
- 6+: D3+3 mortal wounds

trigger.event: enemy unit fought and its attacks destroyed this model

roll.condition: this model was engaged with an enemy WARLORD unit
